segments.text: Mao is introduced as an underclassman that is also the vice-president of the Magical Club. At the beginning of the story, Mao acts like the jealous first year girl that is set on protecting Haruna from Yuuta. She can tell that her senpai has feelings for our protagonist, so she at first tries to keep him from joining the Magical Club.

Unsurprisingly, some her ideas on how a guy should be like tend to be outlandish, but at times does give worthwhile advice. The focus shifts to getting to know our protagonist when she realizes he won't be transforming into a cool guy any time soon.

segments.text: Jack Hammer was a famous action star who played the Evil Magistrate, the main villain on the Global Studios show The Steel Samurai: Warrior of Neo Olde Tokyo. He was the victim in Phoenix Wright's third case, with Will Powers being accused of his murder.

At the height of his popularity, Hammer, while filming a scene, accidentally pushed co-star Manuel onto a spiked fence, which killed him. Dee Vasquez, the producer, covered up the incident and used it to blackmail Hammer into playing low-paid villain roles, including that of the Evil Magistrate.

Eventually, Hammer grew tired of this and formulated a plan to murder Vasquez and frame Powers for it. He drugged Powers with sleeping pills, then stole his Steel Samurai costume and put it on. Faking a limp that Powers sustained in a scene run-through, Hammer moved past the security cameras to implicate him. He went to Studio Two and made to kill Vasquez with the Samurai Spear prop. However, during the struggle, Vasquez accidentally pushed Hammer onto the same fence that killed Manuel, killing him.
Vasquez proceeded to cover up Hammer's death with help from Sal Manella, including driving the corpse to Studio One in an attempt to divert suspicion away from herself and onto Powers.
However, Wright eventually uncovered the truth in court.
Based on his Ace Attorney Wiki page.
